result:
Round 205 passes. Every C acceptance row ran in real Playwright Chromium, comparing the changed tree on :5173 with the round-204 tree (ref) on :5174. browserVerified and realVerified are both true. I changed no app source and made no commits.

**What I checked**
- **Scope (start and end):** HEAD is `135b880`. Only the 4 granted files and 2 new files changed, and all 1035 frozen files match their hashes. The grant diffs contain the three task changes (the gate-204 test/doc fix, the popup dialog, the scroll-lock fix) plus A's one reported extra change, A-1.
- **Popup opening and Tab, at 1280, 1440 and 375:**
  - It is now a real modal dialog with the right name.
  - Focus lands on "Close" 4–59 ms after it appears, with the brass focus ring.
  - Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside the dialog, including after a mouse click on the CZABA wordmark.
  - On ref, focus stays on the page and Tab walks the page behind the popup.
- **Closing, 9 of 9 cases** (Escape, mouse click on ✕, Enter on ✕, at 3 widths):
  - The page keeps its scroll position exactly; ref jumps to 0.
  - Focus returns to the link that had it before, and that link is on screen.
  - The mouse wheel still scrolls, and a reload does not show the popup again.
- **Email and success steps:** focus moves correctly at each step and the error is announced. A's extra change A-1 (focus returns to the email field after a failed submit) works in the browser.
- **Exit-intent trigger at 1440:** a real mouse exit opened the dialog at 3.3 s with focus on Close.
- **Scroll lock in other dialogs:**
  - Sign In on `/` at scrollY 1500 and on `/store` at 800 keeps the position at 1280 and 1440; ref drops to 0.
  - The Studio Export dialog opens and closes the same as ref, and playback still toggles with Space afterwards.
- **Layout:** no element moved (0.00 px difference) and all visible text is unchanged, in all three popup steps at all three widths.
- **Tests:**
  - The 5 targeted test files pass on a copy of the tree (86/86).
  - On the starting code, 17 of the 18 new tests fail, as they should.
  - All 15 of A's deliberately broken versions of the code (mutants) make their tests fail.
  - 5 of my 6 extra mutants also fail. The sixth removes `preventScroll` from the focus restore; jsdom can't model scrolling, so only the browser close rows cover that.
- **Code and docs:** the added lines have no `as`, `any`, `@ts-ignore`, hex colours or focus/ring/outline classes. Every test ID that docs 161 and 162 cite exists in the named test file.
- **Premium auth:** in fresh incognito contexts, `/studio-lab` opens anonymously with no popup. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" and loads no audio. `/api/studio-token` returns 401 without a header and 403 with a fake token. There were no forbidden requests.

**Not claimed:** the full test suite, typecheck, build, Biome and e2e smoke belong to the root gate. Two `useScrollLock` users need the backend and are listed as blocked (the product-page Export dialog and the cart confirm dialog). Export WAV data was out of scope because no audio code changed. WebKit and Firefox were not run.

**Findings for B**
- **C-R205-01 (Low, B should confirm or raise to Medium):** while the email submit is in flight, focus falls to the page body. Tab then reaches header links behind the popup, and Escape does nothing. The window lasts about as long as the network request, and A had already disclosed it. The case for Medium is that this is exactly the containment failure this round fixes.
- **C-R205-02 (Low, also on ref):** the header is meant to be sticky but scrolls off the page. A real user has to scroll back to the top to reach Sign In. Because of this, my Sign In scroll checks open the modal with a script click, as B and A did.
- **Doc 162's status line may block the gate.** It still says it is waiting for C's check, which is the same problem that blocked gate 204. Root or A needs to update it before publishing. I did not edit it.
- B still has to accept or veto A's extra change A-1.

I stopped my ref server and the mock API; the root server on :5173 is still running.

Files are in /home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop:
- c-round-205.md
- c-round-205.json
- c-round-205/ (tools, outputs, screenshots and logs)
